_comment: Word loc -> Konsep library ids (belajar/pipeline/authored/library.concepts.json) that the word illustrates; feeds Word.concepts in schema.ts. Draft as pipeline state (no human review step, plan L11). validate.py checks the map both ways against each concept's `examples`, so every loc listed here must be added as an example of that concept (suggested example notes: al-falaq.new-concepts.md). Ids are listed in library order; the three ids not yet in the library (maqul-al-qaul, zharaf-idza, sighat-mubalaghah) are proposed in al-falaq.new-concepts.md and come last. Syarri in 113:3:2, 113:4:2 and 113:5:2 deliberately has no concept (113:2:2 already illustrates huruf jar + idhafah), so the Konsep pages do not list the same pattern four times.
